title: JBS Dev: On imperfect data and the AI last mile – from model capability to cost sustainability
summary: JBS Dev president Joe Rose challenges the common misconception that data must be perfect before implementing AI workloads. The article explores the 'AI last mile' challenge - translating AI model capabilities into cost-effective, sustainable business solutions. This represents a shift from theoretical model potential to practical, economically viable deployment.
problem_solved: Addresses the barrier of unnecessary data perfection requirements that prevents many organizations from adopting AI solutions.
why_valuable: It reframes a major adoption barrier by showing enterprises can begin AI initiatives without waiting for complete data quality, enabling faster time-to-value.
